answer: Re-attestations are stored in falcon and pulse lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those as the attesters must be independent on the wander graph. Standing lapses unless 2 peers re-attest it every 19 epochs, which means holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1239 impostors cost 1196 times the honest price and take 6 times as long to clear. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
